entries.title: Test input precision with your sync offset
entries.body: Try and save sync offsets, measure timing precision, and get a recommended offset after 20 presses

entries.title: Clearer latency test results and offset controls
entries.body: Adjust the sync offset to recalculate every timing result immediately, with grouped controls and a clearer timing graph

entries.title: The Flatpak opens instead of hanging at startup
entries.body: The Flatpak builds its font cache on first launch, so the window opens instead of hanging with a CPU core at full use

entries.title: Shortcuts follow your keyboard layout
entries.body: Letter shortcuts follow the letters your layout types, while other keys and non-Latin layouts keep key positions

entries.title: Stop preview backgrounds after leaving Preview
entries.body: Standard and Toxi previews now release their animated backgrounds when closed to keep editing and syncing responsive

entries.title: Latency test measures the beat you hear
entries.body: Taps are judged against the audible beat, so results no longer count your audio output delay twice

entries.title: Edit the whole lyrics as text and keep your timings
entries.body: **Edit › Edit as text** opens the whole lyrics as text, and words you don't change keep their timing

entries.title: Find and replace in lyrics
entries.body: `Ctrl+F` and `Ctrl+H` search Edit as text and the import screen, across syllable splits, with patterns and a match list

entries.title: Command palette
entries.body: Press **Ctrl+K** to find and run any command or Preferences page

entries.title: Process lyrics and split syllables in Edit as text
entries.body: Both buttons in **Edit › Edit as text** work on the selected lines, or on everything when nothing is selected

entries.title: Second keys and a keyboard view for shortcuts
entries.body: **Preferences › Shortcuts** shows every shortcut on a keyboard, finds actions by name or key and adds second keys

entries.title: Shortcuts for every menu item and ribbon switch
entries.body: Give any menu item, ribbon switch or Load audio file a key in **Preferences**, and find them all with **Ctrl+K**

entries.title: Open lyrics and audio together
entries.body: Open and Load audio take lyrics, audio or one of each, and dropping a lyric file with its audio opens both

entries.title: Swap duet lines and type whole lines in Edit mode
entries.body: Swap from the Tools or line menu, typed lines split into words, and Edit mode reopens where you left off

entries.title: Role icons across the editor, and a quicker line menu
entries.body: The line menu puts background, duet and swap in one row of icon buttons, and the same icons mark lines and the ribbon

entries.title: File dialogs remember their own folder
entries.body: Open, Load audio and the project pickers each reopen in the folder you last used them in, on desktop

entries.title: Line numbers and role icons in the lyrics text editor
entries.body: The import screen and Edit as text number each lyric line and mark backgrounds, duets and headers with icons

entries.title: Press twice to run for any shortcut
entries.body: Any action can wait for a second press of its key, set in the keyboard view; Auto segment keeps your old setting

entries.title: Tidier shortcut list and command palette
entries.body: Shortcut rows fit on one line and show second keys, and palette rows show their group icon instead of "Command"

entries.title: No Advanced switch in the Preview ribbon
entries.body: Preview has no advanced controls, so its ribbon no longer shows the Advanced switch

entries.title: Saving works again on macOS and Linux
entries.body: Save, Export and settings backups open the system save dialog on every desktop app, where macOS and Linux did nothing

entries.title: Safer handling of shared lyric files and projects
entries.body: Crafted TTML files can no longer freeze the editor, and shared project folders can't redirect saves elsewhere

entries.title: Tooltips stay out of the way
entries.body: Tooltips close as soon as the pointer leaves their control, and stay hidden while a menu or dropdown is open

entries.title: The Flatpak and the fixed AppImage are back
entries.body: The v0.19.0 Linux build stopped early, so it had no Flatpak and an AppImage that lags on newer distros

entries.title: Linux gets a Flatpak
entries.body: Each release has a `.flatpak` that starts where the AppImage failed, like Debian 13, and replaces it

entries.title: Changelog moved into Preferences
entries.body: Open **Preferences › Changelog** to see every release, or show only the highlights

entries.title: Pick a color for the app icon
entries.body: **Logo color** in **Preferences › Appearance** recolors the window, taskbar and shortcut icons

entries.title: Replace selected word combinations
entries.body: Right-click adjacent words in Edit mode and pick **Replace word combination**, keeping their timing slots

entries.title: Lighter visual effects for slow renderers
entries.body: **Visual effects** in **Preferences › Appearance** drops blur, glows and animations, automatic on Linux

entries.title: See what changed after an update
entries.body: The first start on a new version shows a notice that opens the changelog

entries.title: Preferences has new pages and a search that filters
entries.body: Settings are split into clearer pages like **Editing**, **Syncing** and **Backup**, and search hides what doesn't match

entries.title: Unavailable word menu actions look unavailable
entries.body: Disabled right-click actions have dimmed text and a disabled cursor in both designs

entries.title: The Flatpak draws the app's own title bar
entries.body: It replaces GNOME's default header bar with round window buttons and draggable edges

entries.title: Solid cards in Urban Dictionary and the font library
entries.body: Picked fonts show a check, font cards work by keyboard, and Escape closes Urban Dictionary

entries.title: Switching between Edit, Time and Preview is instant
entries.body: Modes no longer fade and slide in, which left the panel blank for a moment and flickered on Linux

entries.title: Spectrogram follows the playhead
entries.body: Pick **Page** or **Continuous** in **Preferences › Spectrogram**, or toggle it with `Shift+P`

entries.title: Separate spectrogram lanes
entries.body: Turn on **Separate lanes** to draw background and duet lines in their own rows

entries.title: One handle at the end of a spectrogram line
entries.body: When a line and its last word end together they share one handle, and `Alt`-drag pulls them apart

entries.title: No more lag spikes on sync keys
entries.body: Pressing `F`, `G` or `H` no longer stalls in long songs

entries.title: Less lag while syncing long songs
entries.body: The editor, preview and spectrogram do less work on each change, so long songs stay responsive

entries.title: See words on the spectrogram as you sync them
entries.body: Each word appears on the spectrogram as soon as you time it, and untimed lines start at their first timed word

entries.title: Audio and playback in one menu
entries.body: Click the music note to open one menu with speed presets, volume, pitch preservation and the loaded song

entries.title: Spicy preview flags timing mistakes and unsynced lines
entries.body: Broken words show in red with a dashed outline, and lines you haven't synced stay visible as hollow letters

entries.title: Spanish (Mexico) interface
entries.body: Pick **Español de México** in **Preferences › General** for Mexican wording

entries.title: Join split words in the Spicy preview
entries.body: A **Join split words** toggle in the Preview ribbon shows a split word as one word, and it's off by default

entries.title: Clearer help for Artists, Songwriter and Sync by
entries.body: The metadata editor says who goes in **Artists** and **Songwriter**, and that **Line** still saves word timings

entries.title: Smoother spectrogram while hovering, scrolling and playing
entries.body: Hovering, scrolling and playing redraw only what changed, so the editor stays responsive on long songs

entries.title: Touch sync panel buttons fire once per tap
entries.body: On iPads and other touch screens, **Start**, **Next**, **End** and the word buttons no longer count a tap twice

entries.title: ASS export opens in ytsubconverter
entries.body: Exported `.ass` files now open in strict tools, and each line fills white over gray while it's sung

entries.title: Smaller download
entries.body: An unused 17 MB dictionary is gone, so the download is smaller

entries.title: Spicy preview matches Spicy Lyrics more closely
entries.body: In Simple Lyrics mode words fill at the same pace as Spicy Lyrics, and **Spicy** is now called **Spicy Lyrics**

entries.title: Show the Advanced switch's knob when it's on
entries.body: With the Spicy Lyrics design, the knob of the **Advanced** switch in the ribbon stays visible when switched on

entries.title: Long translated labels no longer spill out of their space
entries.body: Long option menus, the **Auto-saved at** button and Timing overview titles end in "..." with the full text on hover

entries.title: Held Latin words in right-to-left lines read correctly
entries.body: In the Spicy preview, a Latin word held for a second or more no longer shows its letters backwards

entries.title: One import screen for pasted text, LRCLIB and Genius
entries.body: Pick a source at the top, then clean up, **split syllables** and review Genius sections before importing

entries.title: Switch each Process lyrics step on or off
entries.body: Each step has its own switch under **Advanced**, and running it twice no longer mangles quotes or punctuation

entries.title: Tooltips on ribbon and mode buttons
entries.body: Hover any ribbon control or mode button to see what it does and its shortcut, which follows your keybindings

entries.title: Background vocals render like Spicy Lyrics
entries.body: A line stays active until its background vocal ends, so the next line and interludes no longer start early

entries.title: Spicy preview keeps up with long songs
entries.body: Only lines near the screen stay loaded, and the preview scrolls to the next line the way Spicy Lyrics does

entries.title: Less work per sync key press on long songs
entries.body: Pressing `F`, `G` or `H` no longer redraws the menu bar and closed dialogs on every press

entries.title: Readable shortcut names
entries.body: Shortcuts in menus, tooltips and **Preferences › Shortcuts** read as you'd type them, like `Shift+2` or `Num 5`

entries.title: Preferences search covers descriptions in your language
entries.body: Search covers every setting and description on every page, and accents are optional

entries.title: More Preferences explain what they do
entries.body: Autosave, the Edit/Time playback switch, the Appearance layout picker and Background now have descriptions

entries.title: Half-timed words respond to clicks again in Edit mode
entries.body: A word with a start but no end time now shows a red outline, and clicking it selects it

entries.title: Dragging a word shows where it will land again
entries.body: The drop marker is a bar between words in every theme, and it no longer nudges the line while you drag

entries.title: The ribbon's Advanced switch shows whether it's on
entries.body: When on, the switch now matches the others, and screen readers announce it as **Advanced**

entries.title: Audio bar times stay on one line on macOS
entries.body: The current time and duration no longer push their last digit onto a second line with a wider system font

entries.title: The empty editor's buttons line up when Projects is on
entries.body: With folder projects on, the four buttons sit in an even two-by-two grid instead of one wrapping alone

entries.title: Plain-text import no longer has a Guides tab
entries.body: The TTML guides are still in **Help → TTML guides**

entries.title: Desktop app no longer runs invisibly after a startup error
entries.body: If something goes wrong while starting, the window still opens instead of the app running invisibly

entries.title: Linux AppImage opens on newer distros and plays audio
entries.body: It starts on Debian 13 and other recent distros, audio works everywhere, and NVIDIA needs no workaround

entries.title: Songwriters show correctly in Spicy Lyrics
entries.body: Files saved from the macOS or Linux app or Safari showed "[object Object]" instead of names, so save them again

entries.title: Edit mode stays put when you switch tabs
entries.body: Going to **Time** or **Preview** and back no longer jumps Edit to the playing line or the start of the song

entries.title: Scrolling or zooming mid-drag no longer drops the drag
entries.body: Words and edges stay under your cursor when you scroll or `Ctrl`+scroll mid-drag, and letting go keeps the timing

entries.title: Stretching overlapping words keeps the overlap
entries.body: Each word in an overlapping pair gets its own start and end handle, so dragging one leaves the other alone

entries.title: Easier to seek on the spectrogram timeline
entries.body: The time ruler is taller, seeks as soon as you press it, and follows your pointer while you hold it

entries.title: Screen readers name the audio bar and spectrogram buttons
entries.body: Toggles also say whether they're on, and the spectrogram's Time Shift buttons have names too

entries.title: New Spicy Lyrics design, on by default
entries.body: The editor uses the dark lavender look and Geist type, and you can turn it off in **Preferences › Appearance**

entries.title: Star the project on GitHub from Help or About
entries.body: Stars help more people find the tool

entries.title: The website can no longer be installed as an app
entries.body: The website always opens in a normal browser tab, so use the desktop app for an installed, offline version

entries.title: The website is moving to tool.spicylyrics.org
entries.body: Opening the old address offers to move your projects and settings to the new one, without uploading them

entries.title: The app is now called the Spicy Lyrics TTML Tool
entries.body: It's now **Spicy Lyrics TTML Tool**, or **TTML Tool** for short, in the title bar, About and Discord presence

entries.title: The website no longer works offline
entries.body: The website's offline mode turns itself off on your next visit, so you always get the latest version

entries.title: Help → TTML guides opens the Spicy Lyrics guides
entries.body: It used to point at a documentation page that no longer exists

entries.title: The project now lives at spicylyrics/ttml-tool on GitHub
entries.body: Links in the app and desktop updates now come from the new GitHub address, and old links still redirect

entries.title: Sync background lines in a separate pass
entries.body: **Separate pass** under **Time › Background lines** keeps `G` and `H` on whichever kind of line you start on

entries.title: Duplicate at playhead and auto-segment from right-click
entries.body: The line menu has **Duplicate at playhead**, and the word menu in Edit mode has **Auto-segment selected words**

entries.title: Compact dropdowns in the ribbon and toolbars
entries.body: Where space is tight, choices like **Time › Sync by** and **Background lines** show the current value in a dropdown

entries.title: Advanced editor layout is gone
entries.body: Edit mode always uses the regular layout, with times in the ribbon and split or delete in the word menu

entries.title: Lyrically import is removed
entries.body: Use **Genius**, **LRCLIB** or **Plain text** instead, and existing projects aren't affected

entries.title: Section check warnings are gone
entries.body: Saving and exporting no longer show a section warning, and section headers no longer show an orange count

entries.title: What's New window is removed
entries.body: Everything it covered now lives in **Changelog & updates**

entries.title: Shortcut list is removed from the Time ribbon
entries.body: The shortcuts still work, and you can view or change them in **Preferences › Shortcuts**

entries.title: Start-only first word setting is removed
entries.body: The first word of a line now syncs like every other word, and existing timings stay as they were

entries.title: Genius sections stay together when you edit lines
entries.body: Lines you insert, paste, duplicate or drag into a section join it, and deleting them leaves the section whole

entries.title: Fast syncing no longer drops key presses
entries.body: Pressing `G` or `H` before letting go of the previous key now counts every press

entries.title: Deleting words updates the line's start and end
entries.body: Deleting words with `Delete` now shrinks the line to the words left, as right-click delete already did

entries.title: Duet singers are saved as people
entries.body: Exported files mark the second singer as a person, and the main singer stays first even if agents are listed differently

entries.title: Clearer names for sync tools and settings
entries.body: The F, G and H actions are now **Start**, **Next** and **End**, and several sync settings got plainer names

entries.title: Removed fields and marks Spicy Lyrics ignores
entries.body: Obscene marks, empty beats, streaming service fields and the upcoming-word highlight are gone, but old files still open

entries.title: Ruby editing removed
entries.body: Ruby readings are dropped on import, words and timing stay, and `|` now stays in your text

entries.title: Complete, natural translations in all 15 languages
entries.body: Every language is retranslated in context, missing text is filled in, and joke languages now fall back to English

entries.title: Lyric and audio imports work the same everywhere
entries.body: Repeated LRC timestamps import everywhere, every audio button accepts AAC, and failed loads leave project audio alone

entries.title: Saving and recovery behave the same everywhere
entries.body: Save, guided export, copy and project saves run the same timing checks, and copying keeps your unsaved changes

entries.title: Updates on Windows stop putting the desktop shortcut back
entries.body: Updates use the setup installer now, so deleted shortcuts stay gone, but older MSI installs get one removal prompt first

entries.title: Lyric previews stay in sync with the audio
entries.body: Previews follow the editor's clock through paused seeks and speed changes, and auto-scroll respects your scrolling

entries.title: Beginner guide and Preferences pages translated
entries.body: About 170 pieces of text that were stuck in English or Chinese are now translated in all 15 languages

entries.title: Theme resets and presets cover every appearance setting
entries.body: **Reset theme** and **Reset all advanced overrides** now reset the Genius header color, and presets save space labels

entries.title: No gaps or overlaps in draft word timings
entries.body: Auto segmenting, line sync and new spectrogram setups split time into whole milliseconds with no gaps or overlaps

entries.title: Escape cancels word edits
entries.body: Escape cancels a word edit in Edit mode, and clicked spectrogram dividers take the arrow keys to nudge them

entries.title: Post-chorus sections use their own color
entries.body: Post-chorus sections are purple instead of chorus pink, and section header changes update the words right away

entries.title: Hyphenated words stay whole without Process lyrics
entries.body: With **Process lyrics** off, words like twenty-one import as one word instead of splitting at the hyphen

entries.title: Editor and preview options all live in Preferences
entries.body: Options that were only in ribbons now sit in **Preferences**, and ribbons keep the controls you need while syncing

entries.title: Edit menu shows the right shortcuts
entries.body: **Deselect all lines** and **Delete selection** now show their own shortcuts instead of Select all's

entries.title: Selected system font is marked in the font library
entries.body: The font library marks a system font as selected once you apply it

entries.title: Ignore invisible cover colors in Spicy highlights
entries.body: Fully transparent cover art pixels no longer change the highlight color in the Spicy preview

entries.title: Sync Next no longer overwrites the next word's end time
entries.body: **Sync Next** only sets the next word's start again, instead of also stamping the same time onto its end

entries.title: Exact playback and seeking for every audio format
entries.body: Seeking and sync keys land on the exact time in every format, including VBR MP3s that used to drift up to 2 seconds

entries.title: More control over keyboard shortcuts
entries.body: Reset or clear single shortcuts and get conflict warnings, and zoom, redo and timeline Escape can now be remapped

entries.title: Find the right version of a song faster
entries.body: Online lyric search starts from your audio's tags, and results that match your audio are badged and listed first

entries.title: Simpler editor without the broken extras
entries.body: The AI sidebar, plugins, grammar checker, Developer tab and AMLL preview are gone, and Spicy stays the lyric preview

entries.title: Better sounding slowdown
entries.body: Slowing down with **Keep pitch** on sounds better, and auditions stop exactly at the end of the word at any speed

entries.title: Appearance presets save the font and background too
entries.body: Presets also save font, scale and background, and Edit and Time modes each have their own scroll and highlight settings

entries.title: Song info fills itself in
entries.body: Empty title, artist and album fields fill in from audio tags or confirmed online imports, and typed values are kept

entries.title: Preview skips lines without timing
entries.body: Untimed lines no longer pile up at 0:00, and a banner counts them and jumps to the first one in Time mode

entries.title: Clearer timing and a roomier editor
entries.body: Untimed timestamps look different, the guide counts timed words, and empty translation rows show only when selected

entries.title: Playback speed limits and ESLRC round trips fixed
entries.body: Playback speed is capped at 0.1x to 2x, closing the latency test stops it fully, and exported ESLRC re-imports correctly

entries.title: Selection and audition shortcuts work properly
entries.body: `Ctrl`+`A` selects without deselecting, audition works on words at 0:00, and move-and-play shortcuts start playback

entries.title: Remapped shortcuts work reliably
entries.body: Shortcuts with `Ctrl`, `Shift` or `Alt` work now, `Home` and `End` can be recorded, and `Escape` cancels recording

entries.title: Faster editing in long songs
entries.body: Changing one word's timing only redraws its line instead of the whole lyric list

entries.title: Browsing online imports no longer renames your project
entries.body: Your project is only renamed after you confirm an import, and only if it still has its default name

entries.title: Sync keys give the same time every press while paused
entries.body: While paused, sync keys use the exact playhead and your sync offset, so each press gives the same time

entries.title: Text imports split words predictably
entries.body: Hidden old settings no longer change how imported text splits into words

entries.title: Default shortcuts no longer clash
entries.body: **Audition** uses `Q`, `B` and `N`, **Urban Dictionary** is `Shift`+`F`, and **Auto Segment** is `Shift`+`E`

entries.title: Alt-drag gaps preview correctly
entries.body: Alt-dragging a word boundary on the spectrogram shows the new gap as you drag, without flipping sides

entries.title: Spectrogram ruler keeps its size
entries.body: The time ruler no longer grows on every redraw on high-DPI screens

entries.title: Imported syllables no longer keep trailing spaces
entries.body: Trailing spaces in imported syllables become their own untimed word, so timed words stay clean and spacing is kept

entries.title: Long names fit in the history dialog
entries.body: Long project names and metadata values wrap inside the restore dialog instead of overflowing it

entries.title: Open lyrics file and TTML export are easier to find
entries.body: The open buttons say **Open lyrics file** and accept every format, and **Export** lists TTML first

entries.title: Notifications stay clickable over dialogs
entries.body: Buttons on notifications, like the update **Refresh** prompt, work while a dialog is open

entries.title: Restore the original file of a linked project
entries.body: A header icon restores the original TTML from its one-time backup after confirming, and the Linked tab opens that folder

entries.title: Contributors in About
entries.body: The **About** tab lists everyone who has contributed to this fork, with links to their GitHub profiles

entries.title: Sync times stay accurate when audio stalls or changes speed
entries.body: Synced times no longer drift when audio stalls, buffers or changes speed, and the sync key delay is gone at every speed

entries.title: Keep files in place with linked projects
entries.body: Choose **Keep files in place** to leave your files where they are, and only an explicit save writes back to the original

entries.title: Linked tab and search in the Projects window
entries.body: The Projects window gets a Linked tab, a search field for all project lists, and labels for folder or linked projects

entries.title: Search in Preferences
entries.body: Typing a setting name filters the categories, opens the best match, and highlights the closest setting

entries.title: See what a backup contains before exporting
entries.body: An expandable preview shows category counts, item lists and estimated size before you export settings or data backups

entries.title: Appearance presets and fonts are backed up
entries.body: Appearance presets and the custom font are now exported and restored with the Assets backup category

entries.title: Clearer preset and reset icons in Preferences
entries.body: Preset apply and delete actions have their own icons and tooltips, and reset buttons have better contrast

entries.title: Cleaner dividers where lyric lines meet
entries.body: Touching spectrogram dividers are shorter and have no corner notches, so line boundaries look seamless

entries.title: API keys are opt-in for backups
entries.body: API keys have their own opt-in category, off by default, and recent project paths are no longer backed up

entries.title: Compact timing header in narrow side panels
entries.body: The timing overview header stays readable in narrow panels, and the side preview remembers whether it was open

entries.title: Old tool addresses still work
entries.body: Links to the old tool addresses now redirect to the new site

entries.title: Backup settings fully translated to Spanish
entries.body: Every part of the Backup settings tab now appears in Spanish

entries.title: The app installs as one copy again
entries.body: The duplicate from 0.10.0 and 0.10.1 is removed, and your settings and projects are kept

entries.title: Separate DMG downloads for Mac
entries.body: Mac releases now come as separate Apple Silicon and Intel DMGs, with no universal download

entries.title: App icon has rounded edges again
entries.body: The purple icon is a rounded tile again, so it matches other apps in the taskbar, dock and browser tabs

entries.title: Folder projects (opt-in)
entries.body: Save and organize lyrics as project folders from the File menu, turned on under **Files & Storage** settings

entries.title: Create a project when loading lyrics
entries.body: Loading lyrics with audio offers to make a project folder named after the song, or Untitled Song-1 if there is no name

entries.title: Folder names follow the song
entries.body: Project folders update their name from the song details when you save, but folders you renamed yourself are left alone

entries.title: Files found again after renaming
entries.body: Lyric and audio files are found again after you rename them outside the app, and older projects keep working

entries.title: Project access limited to folders you pick
entries.body: Projects only open folders you choose in the system dialog, and file sizes have a limit

entries.title: Undo history kept after saving
entries.body: Saving clears the unsaved warning but keeps your undo history, and undoing back to the saved version counts as saved

entries.title: Import options open the file picker right away
entries.body: Clicking an LRC, ESLRC, QRC, YRC or Lyricify Syllable option in the **File** menu opens the file picker immediately

entries.title: Save projects with Ctrl+S
entries.body: Inside a project, `Ctrl+S` saves the project instead of exporting TTML, and unsaved changes still get a warning

entries.title: Links show rich previews
entries.body: Short links now show rich previews on Discord, Google, social sharing and search results

entries.title: New multicolor logo and name
entries.body: The new multicolor logo replaces the red icon everywhere, and the app is now named NaeNae's AMLL TTML Tool Fork

entries.title: Toasts with blur and theme colors
entries.body: Toast notifications get a translucent blurred look, follow the global radius and match the theme accent color

entries.title: Jump to words from the timing overview
entries.body: Clicking a word in the Technical Timing Overview jumps to its timestamp, and the table keeps up with playback

entries.title: Playback position kept across tabs
entries.body: Switching between **Edit**, **Time** and **Preview** keeps your playback position and the active line centered

entries.title: Wrapped rows keep their border and highlights
entries.body: Wrapped rows without timestamps show their left border, and syllable highlights stay in sync when selecting or pausing

entries.title: Timing overview order toggle
entries.body: Switch the Technical Timing Overview between time order and lyric text order, with unsynced lines kept in place

entries.title: Smoother spectrogram resizing
entries.body: Resizing the spectrogram no longer redraws parts that did not change

entries.title: Guide links open the current guides
entries.body: Onboarding and Genius token help now open the current Spicy Lyrics guides instead of the retired docs site

entries.title: Words wrap in Time mode
entries.body: Word cards wrap onto new lines, toggled by **Wrap Words in Time Mode** in Display Options or Editor & Sync settings

entries.title: Time mode follows playback
entries.body: The editor keeps the active line centered during playback, and you can turn this off in **Editor & Sync** settings

entries.title: Main vocals take focus during playback
entries.body: Auto-scroll favors main vocals over background vocals, toggled by **Focus Main Line During Playback**

entries.title: Mouse wheel pauses auto-scroll briefly
entries.body: Scrolling with the wheel pauses auto-scroll for a second, then glides back to the active line

entries.title: Record sync keys at the spectrogram cursor
entries.body: An optional setting records `F`, `G` and `H` at the spectrogram hover position instead of the playback time

entries.title: Spectrogram height fits the window
entries.body: The height slider keeps playback controls on screen, and word dividers no longer have a zoom-based minimum length

entries.title: Adjustable interface scale
entries.body: Scale the whole app from **Appearance** settings or with `Ctrl`/`Cmd` and `+`, `-` or `0`, remembered between sessions

entries.title: Background vocal export uses the saved setting
entries.body: Exports now use the saved consecutive and standalone background vocal setting right away

entries.title: Reworked default dark theme
entries.body: Clearer layers, quieter labels and tighter lyric cards, with red kept for active states and main buttons

entries.title: Edit and Time keep the same line in view
entries.body: Switching modes keeps the same lyric line in view without centering lines you are editing

entries.title: Clearer beginner guide
entries.body: A preparation step links the walkthrough to the full TTML guide, with compact source cards and working links

entries.title: Optional background vocal export mode
entries.body: An optional Spicy Lyrics-compatible mode exports background vocal lines, re-imports them reliably and skips empty lines

entries.title: Import options are remembered
entries.body: **Process Lyrics** and Genius songwriter and header options stay set across import sources and app restarts

entries.title: Album art in Discord presence
entries.body: Discord presence shows the project's cover image, and falls back to the app logo when no usable cover is found

entries.title: Word preview plays the exact slice
entries.body: Word previews from the spectrogram play the exact slice on Linux and web, without doubled playback or wrong volume

entries.title: Custom Discord status, with badges that show
entries.body: Write status lines from project, editor and playback details, with timers and auto-hiding after inactivity

entries.title: Quick combine with Shift-click
entries.body: Shift-click **Combine Words** to skip the confirmation and use your last-used combination options

entries.title: Settings grouped in a sidebar
entries.body: Sidebar navigation groups settings by purpose, puts AI setup in one place and hides advanced options until needed

entries.title: Rapid undo no longer freezes the window
entries.body: Undo and redo let the editor repaint between updates, so repeated shortcut presses no longer freeze the app

entries.title: Native Arch Linux package
entries.body: Install natively on Arch Linux and Arch-based distributions, which avoids AppImage compatibility problems

entries.title: Turn off double-click editing in Time mode
entries.body: An **Assistant** setting disables inline word and romanization editing on double-click, while Split Word still works

entries.title: Audio loads again on current Arch and CachyOS
entries.body: AppImage builds use your system's matching audio components, so audio loads on current Arch Linux and CachyOS

entries.title: Move to the new official web address
entries.body: Old domains offer a private transfer of your settings and data before moving to tool.community.spicylyrics.org

entries.title: Classic dark theme as an option
entries.body: A toggle in **Advanced Customization** restores the lighter dark palette used before the Intonated Black redesign

entries.title: Linux window shows on launch
entries.body: The desktop app no longer stays hidden at launch when Linux pauses drawing for hidden windows

entries.title: One title bar on Linux
entries.body: Linux now shows only the app's own title bar, without the system window frame

entries.title: One-click appearance reset
entries.body: A single button in basic appearance settings resets colors, backgrounds, gradients and advanced overrides to defaults

entries.title: Friendlier onboarding
entries.body: Adds a "Before you start" tip, links to appearance settings, and an edge button that brings the guide back

entries.title: Deep black default theme
entries.body: The default dark theme is now deep black, with no washed-out grays and translucent panel overlays

entries.title: Native file pickers on desktop
entries.body: Desktop builds use the system file pickers for lyrics and audio, while the web app keeps its browser picker

entries.title: Pick an import source first
entries.body: The empty editor shows Plain Text, LRCLIB, Lyrically and Genius cards, so you choose a source before its workflow

entries.title: Desktop audio loads reliably on Linux
entries.body: Audio loads on Linux desktop builds without breaking volume or seeking

entries.title: Double-clicking a word stays put
entries.body: In Edit mode the line no longer recenters before the second click lands, and the ribbon keeps a steady height

entries.title: Welcome guide shows once
entries.body: The beginner welcome opens automatically only once instead of on every startup, and stays in the **Help** menu

entries.title: Interactive beginner guide
entries.body: A first-run guide walks through audio, lyrics, timing, credits and export using your own song

entries.title: Connected word groups
entries.body: Split words and words with no space between them join edge to edge, and romanization follows the same grouping

entries.title: Audio bar and lyric lines run edge to edge
entries.body: The playback controls and lyric lines reach both sides of the editor, with no outer margins

entries.title: Blank words show as compact chips
entries.body: Blank words in Edit mode become chips sized by their spaces, with a legacy **Space xN** option in **Appearance**

entries.title: Combine words across all lyrics
entries.body: Preview a combination before confirming, apply it to every match, and optionally ignore case and punctuation

entries.title: Replace romanization across all lyrics
entries.body: Edit one word's romanization or replace every match, with optional case matching and remembered options

entries.title: Timing tools work without Genius headers
entries.body: Copy timings onto existing lines, or snap a selected block to the playhead in Edit and Time mode

entries.title: Desktop window remembers its state
entries.body: Reopening restores the previous window size, and whether it was maximized or fullscreen

entries.title: Polish syllable splitting
entries.body: Polish lyrics get dedicated hyphenation, and the matching splitting method is suggested automatically

entries.title: Discord keeps time per project
entries.body: Discord presence remembers time spent on each project across line changes, pauses, switches and restarts

entries.title: Apostrophe and Cyrillic E cleanup everywhere
entries.body: The apostrophe and Cyrillic E options clean every visible field on import and export, including metadata

entries.title: More reliable and accurate romanization
entries.body: Conversion retries with fallbacks, picks the right Mandarin reading for each character, and keeps mixed-line spacing

entries.title: Word inputs center their text
entries.body: Word and romanization fields size and center their text more naturally, and lyric lines are easier to click

entries.title: Line insert button works while dragging lines
entries.body: The add button at the right of a lyric line works while line dragging is turned on

entries.title: Word-timed lines export correctly
entries.body: Lines with several timed words no longer export as a single line by mistake

entries.title: Optional Discord Rich Presence
entries.body: Desktop users can optionally show their file, editor mode, line progress and play or pause state in Discord

entries.title: PreMiD presence works more reliably
entries.body: The website now shares live editor and playback state with PreMiD, and each version links to its own repository

entries.title: Edit synced words by double-clicking
entries.body: Double-click a synced word to edit it, or its romanization when that is shown

entries.title: Ctrl or Cmd double-click opens Split Word
entries.body: In **Edit** or **Time** mode, `Ctrl` or `Cmd` plus double-click opens the Split Word dialog for that word

entries.title: Song checklist for syncing
entries.body: Keep a saved local queue of songs to sync, with notes and a history of finished ones

entries.title: Recover when the update prompt is missing
entries.body: Website users can force a refresh or clear cached files if an update prompt does not appear

entries.title: Refreshed translations for 16 languages
entries.body: All 16 supported languages have fresh translations

entries.title: No repeated romanization under words in Edit
entries.body: Each word has its own editor now, so the gray romanization text under words is gone

entries.title: Unused grammar Quick Fixes controls removed
entries.body: The unused grammar **Quick Fixes** controls are gone from sync and assistant settings

entries.title: Dragging lines scrolls the editor at the edges
entries.body: Mouse wheel and trackpad scrolling also work while you hold a dragged line

entries.title: AppImage starts reliably on newer Linux
entries.body: The window now shows reliably, so newer Linux graphics setups no longer cause startup failures

entries.title: About and changelog links open in the desktop app
entries.body: They open correctly again, and hosted builds show their commit ID instead of "unknown"

entries.title: Optional AI vibe check sidebar
entries.body: Get a manual vibe check from your own AI provider, from Glazer to Unhinged; off by default, never edits lyrics

entries.title: Optional fix for Cyrillic E lookalikes
entries.body: Corrects Cyrillic Е and е letters hiding inside Latin words in imported lyrics, when turned on

entries.title: Standardize apostrophes on import
entries.body: A setting standardizes curly and other apostrophe-like characters in imported lyrics, metadata, sections and marks

entries.title: Change API Key button is back in Genius import
entries.body: The **Change API Key** button is visible again in the Genius lyric import dialog

entries.title: Waveform playhead recovers from audio stalls
entries.body: It recovers from audio stalls and long frame gaps, and playback stays smooth at slower speeds

entries.title: Easier Genius section editing
entries.body: Duplicated lines get their own repeat-linked sections, and a section manager makes reviewing them easier

entries.title: Auto Segment shortcut with a behavior choice
entries.body: Press the Auto Segment key once or twice, and choose the behavior in the **Keybindings** options

entries.title: Force line rendering in Spicy Lyrics preview
entries.body: A preview toggle makes every lyric line render as a line when line-sync detection is unreliable

entries.title: Section and timing controls are localized
entries.body: Missing translations were added, and the section, timing and auto-segment controls are localized

entries.title: Contractions stay together with curly apostrophes
entries.body: Words like we're and they're stay together when they use typographic apostrophes

entries.title: Desktop updates use permanent versioned installers
entries.body: Desktop builds only check releases that never change, so future updates come from versioned installers

entries.title: Preview keeps line order with out-of-order timestamps
entries.body: The Spicy Lyrics preview shows lines in TTML order even when their timestamps are out of sequence

entries.title: Interlude dots wait only for main vocals
entries.body: Interlude dots ignore background vocal endings and wait only for the main vocals to finish

entries.title: Language-specific segmentation engines
entries.body: Auto Segment and Advanced Segmentation now include English, Spanish, French, Russian, Japanese and CJK engines

entries.title: Word splits are remembered
entries.body: Splits you set by hand can be reused automatically for later occurrences of the same word

entries.title: Split Word dialog remembers your options
entries.body: It keeps your last-used options, so fixing several words takes less setup

entries.title: CJK text splits around commas without spaces
entries.body: CJK text now splits correctly around non-Latin commas, even with no space around them

entries.title: Time stretch can target specific lines
entries.body: Apply it to all lines, selected lines, selected lines and everything after them, or a custom range

entries.title: Clearer Genius section workflow
entries.body: Sections get standard types, repeat detection, a collapsible navigator and live checks, with a review step on import

entries.title: Spicy Lyrics preview mode
entries.body: High-fidelity preview with karaoke, line and Simple Lyrics modes, cover-art backgrounds and an optional FPS counter

entries.title: Stretch timing to match an audio file
entries.body: Import an audio file's duration and scale the lyric timing to match it

entries.title: One import flow for all lyric sources
entries.body: Text, LRCLIB, Lyrically and Genius imports share one flow with replacement confirmation and consistent punctuation

entries.title: Genius headers become color-coded sections
entries.body: Headers like [Chorus] become section metadata instead of lyric lines, grouped and colored by type

entries.title: Backup system for project data
entries.body: A new backup system helps protect your project data and makes recovery simpler

entries.title: Time-mode preview stays on screen
entries.body: The Time-mode preview no longer gets pushed off-screen after loading, and the side pane hides on the full Preview screen

entries.title: Genius imports no longer crash the dialog
entries.body: Genius imports clean up parsed line breaks and no longer crash the import dialog

entries.title: Bouncing dot marks long held syllables
entries.body: In Sync view, a small bouncing dot appears under words of 12 letters or fewer held longer than their length suggests

entries.title: Indicator stays out of the way
entries.body: The dot only appears in Sync mode and hides while a word plays back, keeping the editing surface clean

entries.title: Preview panel no longer crashes the app
entries.body: Toggling the Preview panel in Sync mode no longer leaves a white page

entries.title: Toxi jump-down works with Instant Fade Out
entries.body: The jump-down word animation stays on when **Instant Fade Out** is turned on

entries.title: Instant word highlight option
entries.body: A new toggle in Preview and Sync switches word highlights between smooth fading and instant changes

entries.title: Element Resizing mode removed
entries.body: The experimental mode and its `Ctrl`+`Alt` shortcuts are gone, which simplifies the interface

entries.title: Feature guide covers 12 core tools
entries.body: Each of the 12 core tools has an **Info** button for usage help, translated into your language

entries.title: Millisecond-precise sync timing
entries.body: Sync timing is more precise, and 1 to 3 ms timing errors are now resolved

entries.title: Export checks for untimed lyrics
entries.body: Export runs a sync health check, finds untimed lyrics and offers to jump to the errors

entries.title: Genius imports skip section headers
entries.body: **Process Lyrics** removes headers like [Chorus] and empty lines for a cleaner import

entries.title: New projects open in Standard preview
entries.body: The default preview mode is now **Standard**, for a clearer first look at new projects

entries.title: Confirmation dialogs support custom button labels
entries.body: Dialogs can show custom action labels, and moving between error states works better

entries.title: Smoother rendering on integrated GPUs
entries.body: Less blur, a lighter mesh background and a cheaper text shadow on active words reduce lag and GPU load

entries.title: Background stops animating when paused
entries.body: The mesh gradient freezes while playback is paused, saving power and GPU use

entries.title: Project moved to a new GitHub home
entries.body: The repository now lives at NaeNaeTart/NaeNae-AMLL-TTML-TOOL on GitHub

entries.title: Snap line starts to the playhead
entries.body: Use the round record button in the **Time Shift** toolbar to set line starts to the current playback position

entries.title: Move lines to the playhead from right-click
entries.body: The right-click menu on a lyric line now has **Move line to playhead**

entries.title: Duplicate lines across a spectrogram selection
entries.body: Press `Ctrl+L` to spread duplicated lines and their words evenly across the selected time range

entries.title: Click the title bar mascot for a rain effect
entries.body: Clicking the mascot in the title bar starts the rain, with no slowdown while you edit

entries.title: Title bar mascot loads again
entries.body: The mascot in the title bar shows its animation instead of a broken image

entries.title: Browse and install community plugins
entries.body: A new plugin store inside the app lists community-made plugins you can install

entries.title: Every plugin download is checked before install
entries.body: Each community plugin is verified on download to protect you from tampered files

entries.title: New plugins show up without an app update
entries.body: The plugin list comes from a remote registry, so new plugins can appear without an app update

entries.title: Plugin checks ignore hash letter case
entries.body: Plugins install reliably whether their hash is written in upper or lower case

entries.title: Toxi style with new jump and bloom animations
entries.body: Toxi lines jump down, bloom on hit and fade out smoothly, and the wipe softness is adjustable

entries.title: Smooth lyric animation on high refresh screens
entries.body: Lyrics animate smoothly on 144Hz and faster screens, including ProMotion displays

entries.title: V-Sync toggle and FPS counter
entries.body: Use the V-Sync toggle to uncap your frame rate and the FPS counter overlay to track it

entries.title: Lyric text stays sharp and steady
entries.body: Words no longer look thicker or shift slightly when they change state

entries.title: Advanced appearance editor with 40+ settings
entries.body: Customize backgrounds, glass effects, corner roundness and drop shadows

entries.title: Save and share appearance presets
entries.body: Save your favorite looks as presets, load them instantly and share them with the community

entries.title: Choose whether speed changes pitch
entries.body: Turn **Preserve Pitch** on or off in the audio settings to decide what happens to pitch

entries.title: Audio controls use consistent English labels
entries.body: The new audio controls now use matching English labels

entries.title: Preferences tabs no longer cut off labels
entries.body: Long tab names in languages like Russian scroll sideways instead of getting cut off

entries.title: Urban Dictionary lookups use all selected syllables
entries.body: Select several syllables or words and they are searched as one term

entries.title: One blurred header across the title bar and ribbon
entries.body: The title bar and ribbon share one blur and transparency, with no gap between them

entries.title: Ribbon bars hold their layout at more window sizes
entries.body: Preview and sync ribbon bars render more reliably at different window sizes

entries.title: AMLL preview mode with a gradient background
entries.body: Pick the new **AMLL** preview for a smooth gradient background across the full window

entries.title: Background vocals grouped with their main line
entries.body: Background vocals sit under their main line in italics and grow with it when it becomes active

entries.title: Less lag and CPU use on lyric lines
entries.body: Only the active line gets full animation, and lines off screen are skipped

entries.title: Rendered preview merged into AMLL
entries.body: The preview selector now offers **Standard**, **AMLL** and **Timing**

entries.title: Auto-scroll no longer snaps to the top
entries.body: Auto-scroll stays on the current line, and the AMLL background no longer turns solid black

entries.title: Community plugins, managed from a new Dev tab
entries.body: Plugins can add importers and exporters, and the new **Dev** tab in Preferences manages them

entries.title: Automatic romanization for Japanese, Chinese and Korean
entries.body: Adds Romaji for Japanese and Korean and Pinyin for Chinese, with a project-wide language priority

entries.title: Convert MP3 to FLAC inside the app
entries.body: MP3 files are detected automatically and can be converted to FLAC for more accurate timing

entries.title: Ribbon bar layout and import failures fixed
entries.body: Fixes ribbon layout problems and features that failed to load, with hidden scrollbars in the ribbon

entries.title: One-click lyrics prep for syllable sync
entries.body: **Process Lyrics** splits background vocals and turns plain text into syllable-sync-ready lines

entries.title: AI auto-sync tool removed
entries.body: The experimental AI auto-sync tool is gone, leaving the more predictable local lyrics processing

entries.title: Compact background vocals on the Time tab
entries.body: Turn on **Compact Background Vocals** in Display settings to save space while syncing

entries.title: Shortcuts skip over blank spaces
entries.body: `H` (Set End Time) and `D` (Next Word) now land only on syllables with actual text

entries.title: Imports drop stray backslashes
entries.body: Lyrics from Genius, Lyrically, plain text and LRC import without backslash characters

entries.title: Plain text imports no longer add empty words
entries.body: Separators are removed cleanly, so imports don't leave blank words or stray markers

entries.title: 10-band equalizer with built-in and custom presets
entries.body: Pick a preset like Bass Boost or Vocal Boost, or save and name your own

entries.title: EQ settings and presets are remembered
entries.body: Your equalizer settings and custom presets are saved automatically and kept when you reopen the app

entries.title: Settings panels no longer misalign
entries.body: Content in some settings panels lines up correctly again

entries.title: Duplicate a selection to any spot in the editor
entries.body: Turn on **Duplicate to** to show insertion markers between all lines, then click one to place copies

entries.title: Hold Shift to place copies repeatedly
entries.body: Hold `Shift` while clicking insertion markers to keep placing copies without turning the mode on again

entries.title: Assistant tab in Settings
entries.body: A new **Assistant** tab in Settings holds Quick Fixes and timing visualization in one place

entries.title: Lock timings against typing in Sync mode
entries.body: A new toggle turns off typing timestamps by hand in Sync mode, so timings stay locked

entries.title: Redo uses Shift+Ctrl+Z on all platforms
entries.body: Use `Shift+Ctrl+Z` to redo, the same on every platform

entries.title: Undo and redo keep the last 10 actions
entries.body: Older actions drop out of undo and redo, which keeps the editor lighter

entries.title: No word animations or glow during playback
entries.body: Words no longer animate or glow while the song plays

entries.title: Right-click keeps multi-word selections
entries.body: Multi-word selections survive a right-click, so **Combine Words** works on them

entries.title: Insertion markers no longer overlap
entries.body: Insertion markers stop stacking on each other and sit centered between lines

entries.title: Plain text imports no longer add extra spaces
entries.body: Automatic space padding is now off by default to avoid unwanted spacing in imports

entries.title: Lyrically as a backup lyrics source
entries.body: A fallback lyrics source that still works when Genius blocks imports

entries.title: More reliable Genius imports
entries.body: Genius imports keep working when the site layout changes or blocks standard requests

entries.title: English translations in the import menu
entries.body: Lyrically imports include an English translation and a cleaner preview panel

entries.title: Cover art no longer fails to load
entries.body: Genius cover art loads in the browser without 403 errors or security warnings

entries.title: Better handling of several lyric lookups at once
entries.body: Lookups to different lyric sources at the same time are handled more reliably

entries.title: Searchable font gallery with 300+ fonts
entries.body: Search 300+ popular Google Fonts and system font stacks, with live previews and no clipped names

entries.title: Import your own font files
entries.body: Add .ttf, .otf or .woff files, and they stay saved between sessions

entries.title: Bold and italic for library fonts
entries.body: Bold and italic now work with library fonts, pulling matching styles from Google

entries.title: Review and edit Genius imports before adding them
entries.body: The import preview lets you check and fix lyrics before they go into your project

entries.title: Parenthesized lines import as background vocals
entries.body: Text in parentheses imports as background vocals, and the parentheses are removed

entries.title: Genius cover art loads reliably
entries.body: Cover art from Genius loads on every platform instead of getting blocked

entries.title: Sync whole lines instead of words
entries.body: Set **Time › Sync Level** to Line and empty beats fill in based on syllable count

entries.title: Split words into syllables automatically
entries.body: The **Sub-word split** menu has a **Syllable Split** option that splits longer words for you

entries.title: Community lyric guides on the Import page
entries.body: The Import page now has a catalog of community guides for formatting lyrics

entries.title: Faster double-click editing without Quick Fixes
entries.body: With **Quick Fixes** off, double-clicking opens the inline editor right away

entries.title: Import lyrics from Genius with section tags removed
entries.body: Search Genius and import lyrics directly, with section markers like [Chorus] and metadata blocks removed
